summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K on August 3, 2026, providing notice of redemption and cancellation of listing for $1.45 billion 6.496% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Callable Notes due 2027 and $300 million Floating Rate Senior Callable Notes due 2027. The notes will be redeemed at 100% of principal plus accrued interest on September 13, 2026 (payment on September 14). This is a routine debt redemption, not a special situation; no equity event, merger, or strategic action is involved. The NYSE listing will be canceled after redemption. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; standard bond call mechanics.
